item.g:title: 75 X 3m LMS (Light Mechanical Stress) PVC PIPE
item.g:description: LMS conduits are designed for applications involving light mechanical stress. They are available in 20 mm, 25 mm, 32 mm, 40 mm and 50 mm sizes, with a standard length of 3 metres.
